:::{#sol-matadd-assoc-proof}

Both sides are $m \times n$ [matrices](#def-matrix),
so they are equal when their $(i, j)$ entries agree for every $i$ and $j$.
For each $i$ and $j$,

$$
\ba
((\matr{A} + \matr{B}) + \matr{C})_{ij}
&= (\matr{A} + \matr{B})_{ij} + c_{ij}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\\
&= (a_{ij} + b_{ij}) + c_{ij}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\\
&= a_{ij} + (b_{ij} + c_{ij})
&& \text{(sums of numbers are associative)}
\\
&= a_{ij} + (\matr{B} + \matr{C})_{ij}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\\
&= (\matr{A} + (\matr{B} + \matr{C}))_{ij},
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\ea
$$

where the middle step uses [the associativity of sums of numbers](algebra-sums.qmd#thm-sum-assoc).
So $(\matr{A} + \matr{B}) + \matr{C} = \matr{A} + (\matr{B} + \matr{C})$.

:::
